note: mapping_basis=data_labels. DERIVATION is core model s3 pattern 1: data/spain_2014_family.do infixes DA3032 at the ES3032 DATA LIST positions (P8D01..P8D06 = cols 78-83, identical to ES3032 lines 6-7 and to the questionnaire's column codes (78)-(83)) under lower-cased names, and Bookmark 4 sets item = the variable name (p8d01..p8d06; lower-casing is Stata naming) -- nothing positional, so Step 5b is exempt and no verification_/verify_ files were written. LABELS vs QUESTIONNAIRE: ES3032 VARIABLE LABELS P8D01-P8D06 ('Hacer la colada', 'Hacer pequeñas reparaciones en casa', 'Cuidar a los miembros de la familia que están enfermos', 'Hacer la compra', 'Decidir qué se va a comer al día siguiente', 'Cocinar') match the P.8d grid rows in cues3032.pdf character for character, 6/6 (read from a 300-dpi render of scanned page 3, not OCR; the questionnaire's hyphenated line breaks 're-/paraciones', 'miem-/bros' rejoined; the '.' after 'siguiente' on the printed P8D05 row runs into the dot leaders and is not in the label, so it is not shipped). VALUE LABELS identical on all 6: 1 'Siempre la mujer' 2 'Habitualmente la mujer' 3 'Más o menos por igual o ambos a la vez' 4 'Habitualmente el hombre' 5 'Siempre el hombre' 6 'Lo hace una tercera persona' 7 'N.P.' 8 'N.S.' 9 'N.C.' 0 'No procede' -- codes 1-6 match the questionnaire's printed list and TARJETA F (card printed in capitals; the questionnaire's sentence case, identical to the value labels, is what ships). RESP BY DESIGN: the .do recodes 0, 6 (third person does it, off the woman-man continuum), 7, 8 and 9 to missing, so live resp is {1..5} and option rows ship for those five codes only; code 6 is not shipped because it is absent from the live data. Dropped by the .do (p8d01..p8d06): code 0 877 each; code 6 36/123/16/9/14/23; code 7 0/0/1/0/0/0; code 8 1/0/15/0/1/0; code 9 2/2/29/2/3/2. FILTER: P.8d is asked only 'A QUIENES CONVIVEN CON SU PAREJA (CASADO/A O NO) (1, 2 ó 3 en P.8b)'; DA3032 confirms it -- every record with P8B in {1,2,3} has a P8D01 code 1-9 and every other record has 0 (P8B 0: 657, 4: 4, 5: 205, 6: 10, 9: 1 = 877). The routing header is interviewer text and is not shipped; the public_note carries the population. CHECKED, decisive: reading DA3032 (2464 records, all 385 bytes; id = row number) at cols 78-83, dropping 0/6/7/8/9 as the .do does, with cov_sex col 254 and cov_age cols 255-256 (99 -> NA), reproduces the live table exactly: 9243 rows both, 1584 ids both, 0 only-live / 0 only-rebuilt rows, 0 resp and 0 cov_age mismatches; cov_sex stored as the Stata value label (Hombre 4553 rows, Mujer 4690, no cross cells). Live item x resp (1..5): p8d01 894/290/306/31/27, p8d02 83/32/193/541/613, p8d03 359/227/891/29/20, p8d04 391/226/802/96/61, p8d05 693/325/466/47/38, p8d06 792/280/354/76/60 -- every item uses all five levels; small repairs (p8d02, mean 4.1) is the only man-leaning task and laundry (p8d01, 1.7) the most woman-leaning, as the content predicts. validate_items.R --table-sets passed (6 items, resp {1..5}). TEXT (text_source=study_materials): instructions = the P.8d stem verbatim from cues3032.pdf, shared by all six rows, so instructions not section_prompt, one trivial section; the trailing interviewer direction '(MOSTRAR TARJETA F).' is not read to respondents and is not shipped (same handling as batch_554). translation_source=machine_translation: CIS publishes Estudio 3032 in Spanish only; the _translated columns are English written by this project ('Hacer la colada' rendered 'Doing the laundry') -- issues-page line owed at upload. RIGHTS: instrument_rights_register.csv CIS row (verdict allow, 2026-09-22, every CIS survey year) applied, not re-derived. Not an instrument-name mismatch: the dictionary description (division between woman and man of laundry, small repairs, caring for sick family members, shopping, deciding meals and cooking) matches the six P.8d rows in order. Not confused with sibling _housework (Bookmark 14), a different question block.
public_note: Asked only of respondents living with their partner (married or not); answers of 'a third person does it' (code 6, on the show card) are coded missing, so resp runs only from 1 (always the woman) to 5 (always the man); item text English is IRW machine translation of the Spanish-only CIS questionnaire
